course_name_original: Análisis Contable y Control de Gestión
prerequisites: It is advisable for students to have knowledge of accounting.
It would be convenient, though not mandatory, to have passed the course "Empresa".

learning_outcomes.text: Design cost systems useful for business decision-making.
Understand management control as a tool for developing and implementing strategies and as a means for managers to verify objectives post-factum.
Apply economic-financial analysis techniques and instruments to obtain valid conclusions on the historical and future evolution of companies.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1.- Financial statements and their elements.
Topic 2.- Analysis and interpretation of financial statements.
Topic 3.- Concept of cost and typology.
Topic 4.- Methodology for designing a cost calculation system.
Topic 5.- Decision making and provisional information.
The Accounting as an information system.
The Balance Sheet and its elements.
The Income Statement and its elements.
Techniques and ratios for financial analysis.
Long-term: basic financing ratio, static ratios, dynamic ratios.
Economic analysis: economic and financial profitability.
The cost structure of a company.
Design of cost models in spreadsheet.
Reports for management and types of decisions.
Provisional information: the master budget and budgetary control.
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as (0.125 × P1) + (0.125 × P2) + (0.2 × PA) + (0.55 × E). The course is passed when the final grade is equal to or greater than 50% of the total. No minimum grade is required for P1, P2, or PA. For the extraordinary call, the same criteria apply, using the P1, P2, and PA scores from the course, plus the final exam score from that call. Students with differentiated evaluation will be assessed solely through the final exam, where they can obtain a maximum of ten points in all calls.
